# Alpha Vital Elite IV

> Alpha Vital Elite IV is a physician-directed outpatient IV therapy practice in Middle Village, Queens, New York. Dr. Violeta Aronov, DO, a board-certified anesthesiologist with nearly two decades of clinical experience, reviews each patient's health information, decides whether IV support is appropriate, and personally administers and monitors the infusion. The practice also offers vitamin injections and hydrogen inhalation. Visits are by appointment only, after a free safety screening and physician review.

## Key facts

- Name: Alpha Vital Elite IV
- Type: Physician-directed outpatient IV infusion practice (also injections and hydrogen inhalation)
- Physician: Dr. Violeta Aronov, DO, board-certified anesthesiologist and founder
- Address: 79-01 Metropolitan Avenue, Middle Village, NY 11379
- Phone: (347) 714-8660
- Fax: (347) 714-8685
- Website: https://www.alphaeliteiv.com/
- Hours: by appointment only. Walk-ins are not accepted. Phones are answered Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM.
- Hydrogen inhalation sessions: by appointment only
- Area served: Middle Village and nearby Queens neighborhoods (Forest Hills, Rego Park, Glendale, Maspeth, Ridgewood), Brooklyn and Long Island
- Parking: free
- Payment: self-pay; insurance and HSA cards are not accepted
- How to start: complete the free safety screening at https://www.alphaeliteiv.com/begin-screening/

## How it works

1. Free safety screening: a short questionnaire about medical history, medications and allergies. There is no screening or physician review fee.
2. Physician review: a physician decides whether IV support is safe and appropriate, and which option fits. Completing the screening does not guarantee approval.
3. Scheduling: if IV support is appropriate, Dr. Aronov contacts the patient directly to schedule. The full medical form is completed at the clinic on the day of the visit.
4. The visit: the infusion is prepared, started and monitored by Dr. Aronov or another physician on the medical team from start to finish. It is not handed off to a technician.

## What makes the practice different

- A physician reviews every patient before anything is scheduled, and not every patient is eligible
- The physician who plans the infusion also administers and monitors it
- Ingredients are given in separate, carefully prepared stages instead of one mixed bag, to protect ingredient stability and compatibility
- Infusions are given at a careful rate and are not rushed

## IV infusions and prices (per session)

- Antioxidant x3 Reset: vitamin C, glutathione and alpha-lipoic acid. About 75 minutes. $400
- Immun-O-Boost IV Support: B-complex and minerals, amino acids, vitamin C, glutathione, alpha-lipoic acid and zinc. About 2 hours 30 minutes. $550
- Revive IV Support: hydration with B-complex vitamins, minerals and amino acids. About 1 hour 15 minutes. $325
- LIQUIXO Muscle Recovery: a 20-amino-acid blend with exosome technology, for lean-muscle and recovery support during medically supervised weight-loss programs and periods of reduced nutritional intake. About 45 minutes. $395
- Stress & Brain Wellness: B vitamins, alpha-lipoic acid and taurine. About 1 hour 30 minutes. $350
- Customized IV Infusion: offered when appropriate after a private consultation. Quoted after screening.

## Injections and prices

- Glutathione IV injection: slow IV push given by the physician. About 15 minutes, 30-minute visit. $100
- B12 injection: 5 mg methylcobalamin, intramuscular. $75. A short safety screening is required.
- Vitamin D3 injection: 100,000 IU, intramuscular. $75. Offered when a recent blood test shows a vitamin D level under 30; labs are rechecked at 2 to 3 months before another dose is considered. A short safety screening is required.

## Hydrogen inhalation

- Molecular hydrogen breathed through a personal mask while seated. No needles.
- Sessions run 30 to 90 minutes. $100 per session; the personal mask is $50, one time.
- A brief health screening is required. Not offered to people with an active respiratory infection, severe or advanced lung disease, a heart attack, stroke or unstable cardiac event in the last 6 months, or advanced liver or kidney failure.

## Common questions

- Do I need an appointment? Yes. All visits are by appointment only, after physician review.
- Is there a fee for the screening or physician review? No.
- Do you accept insurance or HSA? No. The practice is self-pay.
- Is there parking? Yes, free parking.
- Who gives the infusion? Dr. Violeta Aronov or another physician on the Alpha Vital Elite medical team, who stays with the patient through completion.
- How long does an infusion take? From about 30 minutes for a glutathione injection visit to about two and a half to three hours for the longest infusions.
- Will an infusion treat my condition? No. The infusions are supportive care only and do not treat or cure diseases or replace a patient's medications, primary care doctor or specialist.
- Can someone with a chronic condition come in? It depends on the condition, current health and the care needed. A physician reviews this before any infusion is offered.

## Important notice

IV services provided by Alpha Vital Elite IV are offered solely as adjunctive wellness support. They are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, mitigate, prevent or reverse any disease, medical condition or aging process, and have not been evaluated by the FDA for those purposes. They are not a substitute for primary or specialty medical care. Physician review and eligibility determination are required before scheduling. Individual results vary; no outcome is guaranteed. Alpha Vital Elite is not a hospital, urgent care center or primary care office.
